footnote_text: Represents shares of restricted stock granted by Outdoor Holding Company (the "Issuer") to the reporting person pursuant to the Outdoor Holding Company 2025 Long-Term Incentive Plan. One-fourth of the shares vested on the grant date. The remainder will vest in three equal installments, with 15,000 of the shares vesting on February 15, May 15 and August 15, 2027, respectively, provided that the reporting person is providing certain services to the Issuer through such dates.
